```python
def get_height(node):
    if not node:
        return 0
    left_height = get_height(node.left)
    if left_height == -1: return -1
    right_height = get_height(node.right)
    if right_height == -1: return -1

def num_comm_div(a, b):
    # Find the minimum of the two numbers
    min_num = min(a, b)
    
    # Initialize the common divisor to 1
    common_div = 1
    
    # Iterate from 2 to the minimum of the two numbers
    for i in range(2, min_num + 1):
        # Check if both numbers are divisible by i
        if a % i == 0 and b % i == 0:
            # Update the common divisor
            common_div = i
    
    return common_div
